{"title": {"from": "Node QA pass: owner's per-node changes + plain tooltips (collecting; wait for go)", "to": "Node QA pass: owner's per-node changes + plain tooltips"}, "spec": {"from": "Node QA pass (owner, 2026-11-03): per-node layout and UX changes from the owner's walkthrough of /obj/a3ob_node_zoo, plus plain-language tooltips everywhere. The advisor appends a section per node as the owner finishes it; do not start until the advisor says the list is complete. Owner layout edits are read from the sandbox definitions (exportTests/hda_sandbox/, gitignored, baseline dialog scripts in exportTests/hda_sandbox/baseline/) and copied into each node module's SPEC; HDAs are regenerated with scripts/build_hdas.py, never saved from the GUI.

A. Generator support
A0. Houdini help (Help section, #33) fixes found by the advisor reading the live help server pages (nodes/sop/a3ob_p3d_export, a3ob_validate, a3ob_mass): (a) wiki markup is not escaped: the Selection Mask default "* ^__*" renders as bold/italic; escape *, _, and any other wiki markup characters in defaults, labels and help text (test: the rendered or generated text for selmask shows "* ^__*" literally; labels with an inner colon such as "T2-UV2: At most 2 UV sets" render as one label). (b) menu choices without their own help get the filler "Sets this to <label>."; drop the filler and give each choice real help (Z1). (c) inputs show the filler "Input 1."; give each input a one-line description from the node SPEC (input_labels plus text). (d) when a menu's tooltip is split into per-choice lines (Check: "Every cook: ..."), keep the parameter's own first sentence and start each choice line with a capital.
A1. Parm gains a visibility condition (Houdini hidewhen, and disablewhen if cheap), written by hda_source.py into the DialogScript; build_hdas.py --check and build_user_docs.py --check stay clean, and the generated reference pages say when a parameter is shown (for example "shown when Mode is Uniform total").

B. Mass (a3ob_mass)
B1. Replace the shared "value" parameter with three: mass_each "Mass per Point (kg)", mass_total "Total Mass (kg)", density "Density (kg/m³)" (internal names may differ; keep them stable afterwards). Each is shown only for its mode (Set on each / Uniform total / From density) and hidden for Clear / Copy from mass / Copy to mass. Defaults as today (1.0) unless the owner says otherwise; minimum 0, no maximum.
B2. Everything that sets or reads "value" moves to the new names: new_p3d.build_starter (Uniform total 100 kg), tests, docs/user generated reference, any preset or doc text.
B3. hython test: each mode reads only its own parameter; the hidden ones do not change the result.
B4. Old scenes keep their mass: a Mass node saved with the old "value" parameter loads with that value in the parameter of its mode (keep "value" as a hidden legacy parm read on cook, or migrate it on load; say which). hython test loads an old-style node and checks the cooked a3ob_mass.

C. P3D Import (a3ob_p3d_import)
C1. "File" tooltip: the owner did not know what "MLOD" means. Plain version, e.g.: "The .p3d model to open. Use the editable version Object Builder saves (MLOD). Files taken out of the game's packed PBOs (binarized, ODOL) can't be opened." The error for an ODOL file says the same in plain words.
C3. "LODs" needs the user to know the file's LOD order. Add a toggle menu (Houdini menutoggle on the string parm, via the existing menu_action mechanism) filled from the chosen file's LOD list by display name with its index ("0  Resolution 1", "5  Geometry"); picking an entry adds or removes its index in the field. Read only what is needed to list the LODs, so large files stay quick (state how long it takes on the largest Arma 3 Samples file, Test_Plane_01.p3d, 12 MB). The field also accepts LOD display names and * patterns ("Geometry Memory", "Resolution*"), case-insensitive, alongside numbers and ranges. Tooltip: "Which LODs to bring in. Pick them from the menu, or type numbers or names. * means all." hython tests for the menu items and for name/pattern selection; an unknown name is a clear warning.
C2. "Explicit Face Groups" tooltip explains in plain words what a face group is and when you would want one for every selection.

D. Material Assign (a3ob_material_assign)
D1. Set Texture / Set Material tooltips say what the box is for and what each state does, e.g. "On: this node gives the polygons the texture chosen below. Off: the polygons keep the texture they already have (from the file or an earlier node), for example when you only want to change the material." (Material: same pattern.)
D2. Texture File becomes a file picker (patterns *.paa *.tga *.png, read mode); Material File becomes a file picker (*.rvmat). Slash handling and the export's relative-path option are unchanged; the tooltip says the export makes the path relative to the project root.
D3. Color becomes a colour picker with alpha (Houdini colour parm, RGBA). Generator support for a colour kind if needed (A section). Old scenes keep their colour value (same parm name, or migrate as in B4).
D4. Rename for meaning (internal names may stay): Texture Source choice "Custom" -> "Custom texture text"; "Raw Text" -> "Texture Text", tooltip: what a texture line is, with an example procedural (#(argb,8,8,3)color(1,0,0,1,CO)) and that it is copied exactly; "Common Procedural" -> "Pick a Common Texture" (copies a frequently used texture line from the common data file into Texture Text and switches the source to Custom texture text); "Add Common" -> "Pick a Common Material".
D5. Visibility (needs A1): Texture File only for source File; Color and Color Type only for Color; Texture Text and Pick a Common Texture only for Custom texture text. All texture fields disabled when Set Texture is off; Material File and Pick a Common Material disabled when Set Material is off.
D6. Tests: hython checks the parm kinds (file, colour), the hide/disable conditions per state, and that cooking with each source still writes the same a3ob_texture as before.

E. Proxy (a3ob_proxy)
E1. Path becomes a file picker (*.p3d, read mode). A picked absolute path (P:\a3\data_f\proxies\weapon_slots\top.p3d) gives the same proxy name as typing the P-drive path: .p3d dropped and / as \ (as today), and made relative to the project root on export when that option is on. Tooltip says so. hython test with a picked-style absolute path.

F. LOD Properties (a3ob_lod_properties)
F1. Owner layout (exact dialog script saved at exportTests/hda_sandbox/owner/a3ob_lod_properties.ds): the "props" multiparm sits inside a Simple folder (group box) labelled "Properties", and the "copies" multiparm inside a Simple folder labelled "LOD Copies". Everything else unchanged. Give the folders stable names (e.g. props_box, copies_box; the owner's were auto-named folder0/folder1).
F2. Generator support (A section): a folder kind in params.Parm (Simple / Collapsible / Tabs) with children, written by hda_source.py, shown as headings in the HTML reference and the Help section. read_parms and every node's cook ignore folders.
F3. Test: the generated a3ob_lod_properties definition's parm template tree matches the owner's (folder types, labels, children order), compared structurally, not as text.

G. P3D Export (a3ob_p3d_export)
G1. Owner-approved layout (exact dialog script: exportTests/hda_sandbox/owner/a3ob_p3d_export_proposal.ds; the owner's own first draft is a3ob_p3d_export.ds beside it). Top level: Output File, Save to Disk, Keep a .bak. Then tabs (Houdini Tabs folders) in this order: "Error Checking" (check, errorlevel, strict, dupes, maxmessages), "Presets" (preset, apply), "Paths & Names" (relpaths, projectroot, lowercase, czech, renumber), "Selections" (selmask, autocomponents), "File Layout" (sortlods, sortsections, dropuvs), "LOD Rules" (typerules, then every rule switch). Folder names stable: tab_checking, tab_presets, tab_paths, tab_selections, tab_layout, tab_rules. Parameter names unchanged.
G2. Rule switch labels drop the "T2-XXX: " prefix ("At most 2 UV sets"); the rule id moves to the end of the tooltip ("(Rule T2-UV2.)") and stays in messages and docs where it helps searching.
G3. Validate gets the same "Error Checking" and "LOD Rules" tabs, built from the same shared parm lists (_export_common.level_parms / rule_parms), so the two nodes cannot drift.
G4. Project Root becomes a folder picker (Houdini directory chooser); empty still means the shelf settings root, then P:\.
G5. Selection Mask UX: keep the field and its syntax, add a toggle menu listing the input's point groups by decoded P3D name (picking one adds or removes it in the mask, like Houdini group fields), and an info line on the node "N selections will be written" (per LOD or total). Plain tooltip: "Which point groups become selections in the file. Leave as is to write all of them except Houdini's internal ones (names starting with __)." Test the menu items and the count line.
G6. Owner D26: a newly created P3D Export node starts from the active preset of the Project root and presets settings (an OnCreated step that applies it, so the HDA's parameter defaults and old scenes are unchanged); with no settings file it starts from Lossless. New P3D's starter export does the same. The Preset menu shows which preset was applied. hython test with a temp settings file whose active preset is Arma 3 release, and with none.

Z. Tooltips (after all node sections)
Z1. Every parameter of every A3OB node has a tooltip in plain words: what it does, in one or two short sentences, units where there are any, and for menus what each choice does. No internal ids, no spec references. Tooltips the owner typed in the sandbox are kept word for word.
Z2. Shelf tool helpText is rewritten for users (no "The work is in ..." developer notes).
Z3. A test fails if any A3OB parameter (multiparm children included) has an empty tooltip.

Gate: scripts/build_hdas.py --check and scripts/build_user_docs.py --check are clean after the SPEC changes; labels quoted in the #28 guides are updated to match; quick gate passes on CPython 3.12 and hython 3.13. Runs after #28 merges.

C. P3D Import (a3ob_p3d_import)

C3. "LODs" needs the user to know the file's LOD order. C2. "Explicit Face Groups" tooltip explains in plain words what a face group is and when you would want one for every selection.

D1. Set Texture / Set Material tooltips say what the box is for and what each state does, e.g. "On: this node gives the polygons the texture chosen below.
